<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

This discrepancy causes confusion, delays in month-end reporting, and undermines confidence in critical financial data [i:02bd63a3409aa690][i:2297961a34558bd4][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed].\n\n## Who is affected\n- **Finance teams** at customer accounts, who are directly questioning the reliability of the numbers and experiencing delays in their reporting processes [i:3c15351d383b6349][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed].\n- **Account managers and support teams** at Keelwater, who are fielding complaints and troubleshooting these issues from multiple customer routes [i:2297961a34558bd4][i:4c1e1128bbb746cc].\n\n## Evidence\n- This issue has been mentioned 14 times across 7 accounts, representing a total ARR of £6,880,000.0 [i:02bd63a3409aa690][i:2297961a34558bd4][i:3c15351d383b6349].\n- The problem has been reported via three different routes: 10 mentions from support, 3 from account management, and 1 from sales [i:4c1e1128bbb746cc][i:d17400eba81e6607][i:3c15351d383b6349].\n- Four of the affected accounts are up for renewal within the next 90 days: Stannary Commercial (renewal 2026-12-05), Marrowgate Commercial (renewal 2026-12-12), Hollinbrook Home Insurance (renewal 2027-01-15), and Quillon Business Insurance (renewal 2027-01-20) [i:2297961a34558bd4][i:4c1e1128bbb746cc][i:3c1cd3444487dcf6][i:551e3ef68cf180fa].\n- Customer quotes describe the impact: \"our finance team’s pulling their hair out — the dashboard totals don’t match the CSV exports, causing export figures mismatch headaches\" from Thistlecombe Mutual [i:02bd63a3409aa690]; \"it’s causing real delays because they can’t trust which numbers to use for month-end reporting\" from Tidewell Marine & Cargo [i:3c15351d383b6349]; and \"Finance keeps questioning the numbers because the dashboard totals don’t match the export figures mismatch — I’ve re-exported three times and it’s consistent with UTC cutoff, not UK time\" from Marrowgate Commercial [i:ccfc25a70dd3f36d].\n- One insight from Duncastle Auto suggests a user has checked roles and tasks, finding them correct, but \"the numbers still don’t match what we submitted last week,\" indicating the issue may persist even after configuration checks [i:c2ebffe834fdf50b].\n\n## Why now\n- The issue has been actively reported over the last two months, with multiple mentions in September and October 2026, indicating it is a current and ongoing pain point [i:02bd63a3409aa690][i:2297961a34558bd4][i:3c15351d383b6349].\n- With 4 renewals due in the next 90 days, representing a significant portion of the affected ARR, the risk of customer churn or renewal friction is heightened [i:2297961a34558bd4][i:4c1e1128bbb746cc][i:3c1cd3444487dcf6][i:551e3ef68cf180fa].\n- The problem is causing tangible business impact, as finance teams are explicitly linking the data mismatch to delays in their month-end close processes [i:3c15351d383b6349][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed].",

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the ARR total (£6,880,000), mention count (14), account count (7), and route breakdown (10 support, 3 account management, 1 sales) against the fact sheet — all match exactly. The four renewal accounts and dates (Stannary 2026-12-05, Marrowgate 2026-12-12, Hollinbrook 2027-01-15, Quillon 2027-01-20) are all within 90 days of the 2026-11-03 as-of date and align with the fact sheet. The three customer quotes in quotation marks match the cited insights verbatim, and the Duncastle Auto paraphrase with a partial quote is accurate. The 'last two months' claim is supported by September and October 2026 dates across the cited insights. No uncited claims, overstated numbers, or ignored contrary evidence found.", "verdict": "pass"}
